title: What God Calls the Reflex You Call "Just Checking My Phone"
caption:
Forty checks before lunch and nothing was actually urgent. That's not a focus problem. That's an avoidance problem wearing a productivity excuse.

The reflex doesn't want the notification. It wants ten seconds filled with anything but silence, and silence is usually where God speaks first.

Put the phone somewhere that costs you a walk to reach. Then decide what fills the gap before the gap fills itself.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #digitaldiscipline #selfcontrol
